name: refactor-rename
description: Rename fetch_records -> load_records across five modules and the test file, without disturbing the wire-protocol string literal of the same name.
proves: multi-file editing that has to be complete (the suite breaks on a single missed call site) and discriminating (a blind search-and-replace breaks the frozen string literal)
prompt:
Rename the function `fetch_records` to `load_records` throughout this project: its definition, every import, every call site, and the tests. Keep the behaviour identical.

One thing must NOT change: the string literal "fetch_records" that `EVENT_NAME` is set to in `app/store.py` is a wire protocol event name that other services subscribe to. Leave that literal exactly as it is.

`python3 -m unittest discover -q` must pass when you are done. Do not commit anything to git.

pre_checks.label: the fixture's test suite passes before the refactor
the old name is present before the refactor

checks.label: no unquoted fetch_records identifier remains anywhere
the definition carries the new name
nothing outside the project was touched
